author: Good Enough
description:
If an orca attacks you, staying calm and reacting correctly could save your life.

Despite being one of the ocean’s most powerful predators, wild orca attacks on humans are extremely rare. This video explains what to do during an orca encounter, the mistakes that could make the situation more dangerous, and how to improve your chances of escaping safely in open water.

This Short breaks down survival tips for one of the most intimidating animals in the ocean.
title: If an Orca Attacks You, Do This 🐋😲 #wildlife #survival #animals #facts
